**Pre-release for testing — not a stable version.** Clean-room Rust post-processor for scanned books: split → deskew → crop → clean/binarize → PDF with an OCR text layer. GUI in 8 languages (ro, en, fr, it, es, pt, de, hu) and command line. MIT licence, runs locally, no accounts.

## Downloads
Pick the archive for your system; every archive has a `.sha256` next to it.

| System | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x86-64 / ARM64 | `*-linux-gnu.tar.gz` | glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12 and later); OpenGL 2+, X11 or Wayland |
| Windows x86-64 | `*-windows-msvc.zip` | no Visual C++ Redistributable needed; OpenGL 2+ |
| macOS Apple-silicon / Intel | `*-apple-darwin.zip` | unsigned: right-click → Open on first launch |

OCR needs `tesseract` (with the language packs you want) installed separately.

## New since 0.2.0-pre.2
- **Bug found by the new OCR benchmark and fixed:** a dark scanner-edge bar next to the text could rotate the page by 90°, hide the skew or crop away half of the text. Fixed with regression tests (`docs/OCR-BENCH.md`: 8 languages × clean / scan / bad pages, error rates 0–1.5 %).
- **Manual picture zones:** `--picture-zone X,Y,W,H` (and a GUI field in mixed / hybrid mode).
- **Word export with paragraphs:** paragraph breaks are recovered from the line spacing; lines of one paragraph flow together.
- **Fuzzing of the archive, PDF-text and search readers** found and fixed one real crash (a character boundary in HTML-entity decoding). New weekly fuzz target `fuzz_readers`.
- **CI:** every release target now runs the packaged binary on a sample page (`--version`, profiles, image → PDF); a veraPDF job validates `--pdfa` output (reporting only); a daily RustSec dependency audit.
- `--compare-text` computes character / word error rates between two text files.

## Known limits
- PDF/A-2b is **not certified**: the veraPDF job exists but its result is not yet a release gate.
- Not done: drawing picture zones or the content box with the mouse on the page, dewarp control points, a native OCR engine (Tesseract is still required).
- JBIG2 Huffman coding and some JPEG 2000 code-block styles (bypass, termall, POC/PPM/PPT) are decoded only through an installed `pdftoppm`, `mutool` or Ghostscript.
- Only the empty user password is tried on encrypted PDFs.
- Archives: zip and tar/tgz were tested; 7z and rar were NOT tested (no extractor was available to the author). Search, Word export and the new profiles were verified on Linux x86-64 only (OCR with the English model; the Romanian model was not available to the author). The Word file opens in LibreOffice and python-docx, not tested in Microsoft Word. The text search of PDFs not written by LegatorOCR was not tested on ABBYY/PDF24 files. Verified by hand on Linux x86-64 only; the Windows, macOS and ARM64 builds come from CI and were checked for format and dependencies, not run by the author. The GUI was smoke-tested, not exercised in depth.

Documentation and presentation: https://legatorocr.chiuta.ro · Source and comparison with other tools: README.md, COMPARISON.md.
